author: Krono I
title: PPO with CNN-LSTM (JIT-Stable Version)
abstract: Third attempt at a PPO implementation. Previous run (ID 18) failed due to a suspected JIT compilation error from overly complex nested lax.scan calls. This version replaces the outer epoch and minibatch loops with standard Python for-loops, which the JIT compiler unrolls. This creates a simpler computation graph, aiming for stability to finally test the PPO algorithm's effectiveness.
